function_pointer_behavior: Ignores a0: neither stores nor invokes the callback. Returns zero. This game supplies a no-op atexit implementation, not an exit-handler registry.
caller_scan_scope: Every word in every function of config/rom_cpu_catalogue.json; J/JAL decoded with the PC region. One direct caller. Indirect callers and uncatalogued code are not ruled out.

direct_callers.argument: a0 = 0x801EF7A0 (func_801EF7A0_1416C0), formed by lui/addiu around the jal; v0 is discarded

identity_reason: The caller follows guarded construction of the interpreter's function-local static. Pinned g++ 2.8.1 emits __tcf_0, the interpreter, _GLOBAL_.I.func_801EF7F0_141710 and an undefined atexit call. The ROM has exactly this registration pattern. The runtime name is identified from compiler emission plus ROM callsite, not the trivial callee body alone.
